hero.headline: This isn’t open
hero.lede: {handle} gives out codes when there’s a reason to talk — a hiring loop, an investor call, an advisor scoping, a piece of press. If you have a code, drop it in. Otherwise — bring your own AI to chat with the public corpus{note}.

footnote.text: <muted>how this works</muted> · standmeet replaces a résumé / linkedin / cold-email reply with a scoped, on-the-record conversation. it isn’t a chatbot demo. every code is hand-issued and every transcript is reviewed by {handle}.

whatsBehind.chatBody: There's no résumé to scroll. You ask questions, an AI answers in the owner's voice, grounded only in things they've actually written.
whatsBehind.sliceBody: Each code unlocks a specific slice of the corpus — e.g. interview slice, investor slice, advisor slice. Private topics stay redacted.
whatsBehind.recordLabel: a single conversation, on the record
whatsBehind.recordBody: The owner sees the transcript afterward. Treat it like a meeting with someone who can't make the time, not like ChatGPT.

codePanel.captchaHint: too many tries from here — clear this and your code will go through
codePanel.hint: codes look like <sample>OAEN-3K2</sample> · the owner bakes them into a QR code or link · case doesn’t matter · paste the whole thing (with or without the dash) and press enter.
codePanel.nameHint: your name lets the owner separate visitors who share the same code.

byoai.headline: Bring your own AI
byoai.lede: Use your own key against the owner’s public corpus. Pick any OpenAI-compatible provider, or point at your own self-hosted endpoint. Private topics return “need a code”.
byoai.bulletKey: your key never touches our server — stored encrypted in your browser only
byoai.bulletPays: owner pays for retrieval, you pay for inference
byoai.bulletPrivate: private topics return “ask for a code”
byoai.keyNote: never uploaded · stored encrypted in your browser
byoai.fillHint: fill endpoint, model + key to unlock the public chat.

request.headline: Tell {handle} who you are
request.lede: A short note. If it’s useful to talk — through the AI or in person — they may send you a code. Read by hand, not a queue.
request.footerNote: goes straight to the owner · read by hand
request.sentBody: Thanks, {name}. The owner reads these by hand — no bot, no queue. If it’s a fit, they’ll reach out to <accent>{email}</accent> themselves with a code and which slice of the corpus it opens.
request.sentTail: Not every note gets a reply. If you don’t hear back in a week, that’s the reply.
